name: 10438-sharedprefix-qwen3next80b-tp4
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=5 and pinned, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 500 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 10438: each request is one of fifty distinct 10240-token preambles followed by a unique 256-token question and generates 128 tokens, all three lengths fixed.
purpose: A document question-answering service over fifty shared reference texts, five concurrent users, 80-billion-parameter model on four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit 19ba16aa3d71ea8372c94140e6d3fccee9ca906f
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.5.3.post1-78-g19ba16aa3d7); the interpreter is named by env.yaml.
#
# FLAT PARSER: `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED
# silently, and the engine then starts without something this file claims to declare.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
context-length: 16384
random-seed: 10438
